text: Four stars because there is always room for improvement. I started using ToDo by Appigo many years ago and it met my needs but then they made an update that I did not like and they got greedy with their pricing. After dumping them, I downloaded and tried at least a dozen different reminder programs and Taskito was by far the most worth keeping. I signed up for a year - which is something I swore I would never do (I either outright own it or I am not buying it), but Taskito changed my mind. So far so good. My two complaints are: - doesn't sync with Google as easy as I would like. I wish it were possible for reminders to automatically sync rather than having to press a specific button. Despite having a new G5 phone, I find Google calendar unacceptably slow when used from Taskito. almost like the phone has crashed. - my second criticism is that the interface isn't configurable.ToDo Cloud was pretty good for that until their update but other than selecting colours for tags, Taskito doesn't allow for much user customizing. I especially find it frustrating when I go to my Board and see how much screen space is occupied that is just blank screen. Individual notes or tasks within a also take up a lot of room once it has a priority and tags associated with it. I'd like to see a user-defined spacing layout or at least compress tags or make it a sub-folder within a task. If the latter was addressed, I'd give it 5 stars and be a permanent user.

text: Taskito does a really great job, definitely the best productivity tracker compared to almost 20+ prod. apps I've tried in the past. Its Timeline gives a clearer and more organized view on your tasks, and each task gets to have "priority, tagging, subtask, description, etc" and able to copy or put it on Unplanned - w/c is another feature of Taskito where all tasks w/o dates are sorted onto another page. This app also have this Board where sort of projects have corresponding task list inside it which all the more making not only your task, but projects/plans on check systematically. I've became more motivated to accomplish and write a task because of Taskito. This is really impressive. Do a combination of task + note will make your timeline eye-pleasing and detail-oriented (i.e. can make a note regarding a task you've complicated) everything is in one place. What more? You won't miss the important functions on their FREE subscription, so you won't get forced on availing their Premium subscription w/c by the way not that expensive unlike other apps that are expensive yet not worth it, but in Taskito I'm confident even availing Premium isn't a waste! I am truly sticking to Taskito as this app is impressive, and their dev/customer team is truly accommodating - they're continuously improving the app. Highly recommended above 💯-grade, this is the best!
